items.title: Louis Armstrong Interview, 1971-07-09
items.q: The interviewee (Louis Armstrong) discusses 'Lewis' (likely Louis Jordan, referred to as 'Lewis' or 'Lewis Scott' in the transcript context of Cab Calloway's imitation) primarily as a stylistic influence and a figure whose cornet playing and persona were notable to musicians.
